name: cc-flow
description: Turn requested software changes into auditable development workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, implement, test, and review software changes
interface.longDescription: CC Flow turns requested software changes into an auditable workflow, checks product intent, separates needs from solutions, prefers reuse, and guides implementation, testing, and review. Routine Git integration, release, and deployment execution stay outside the workflow unless code or configuration changes are required.
defaultPrompt: Use CC Flow to implement this feature.
